title: The 2001 draft human genome paper
summary: The International Human Genome Sequencing Consortium published the initial sequence analysis in Nature in 2001.
body: The International Human Genome Sequencing Consortium, "Initial sequencing and analysis of the human genome" (Nature, 2001), is the draft-genome paper. It is not the 2022 complete sequence and it is not a claim that every base was known in 2001.
